title: FKG
description: A mod that aids in pricing for kuudra items.
body:
FKG Mod is a Minecraft mod designed specifically for Hypixel Skyblock. It helps players get prices for Kuudra items efficiently. 

Commands:
/value - Gets the value of the item you are holding, NOTE this needs to be a kuudra item
/craftprice - Gets the price to craft an attritube with a certain level, gives you what to buy
